instance-missing.json.reason: the batch ID names its instance

no-records.json.reason: a batch holds at least one record; the gateway sends none when it has nothing

record-id-duplicate.json.reason: record IDs are unique within a batch

record-instance-mismatch.json.reason: every record comes from the batch's instance

record-missing-field.json.reason: every record is a complete usage record

too-many-records.json.reason: a batch holds at most 500 records
